data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish this lake, and I want it to keep supporting our village for years to come. With 100 tons in it now, we can catch 50 tons total and leave enough for it to replenish fully next month. How about we each agree to catch 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that each month if we stick to the limit. John, what do you think?
